coordinate_interpretation.issue: The selected upper and lower court points were geometrically consistent, but the far and near labels were interpreted opposite to the stored coordinate convention.
coordinate_interpretation.resolution: Reassign the mirrored landmark identities without changing any selected image coordinates.
coordinate_interpretation.final_convention: x=0 at the right baseline and increases toward midcourt; y=0 at the far bench-side sideline and increases toward the near sideline.

excluded_landmarks.baseline_far_lane_corner: The original UI point 4 was substantially covered by a player. It is retained as a validation point but not used to solve the homography.
excluded_landmarks.baseline_near_three_point_intersection: The original UI point 6 was outside the visible frame. It is retained as an approximate validation point but not used to solve the homography.

visual_review.far_sideline_note: The bench-side boundary is outside the fitted landmark region and is therefore an extrapolation. It should not be used as the primary accuracy measure for player positions inside the three-point area.

next_validation: Propagate the reviewed reference homography through the moving-camera frames and inspect projected court markings at multiple timestamps before exporting player coordinates.
